limitations: Endpoint selector need not equal unique support coordinate — Counterevidence: Lemma2.8 is consistent: null selector modifications leave pi unchanged.

Endpoint selector need not equal unique support coordinate — Counterevidence: No endpoint normalization or torus identification of the support square is imposed.

Endpoint selector need not equal unique support coordinate — Counterevidence: Theorem1.13 requires more restrictive coupling; Theorem1.22 requires independent curves, so this construction does not refute either theorem.
Endpoint selector need not equal unique support coordinate — Not verified: Every fixed deterministic interior time under arbitrary coupling; full boundary re-rooting formulation.
Limitations: No writes, compilation, rendering, image viewing, author code, human review or backend identity verification.

Counterevidence: The conditional first assertion requires a uniquely hit target point and does not apply to infinity. Property (vi) is for z in C. The source itself confirms diagonal support in the identical-curve example.
